title: Colonization of Government Lands Amendment Ordinance 2010

sections.shortTitle: Colonization of Government Lands Amendment Ordinance 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VI OF 2010
ORDINANCE VI OF 2010
COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT
LANDS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2010
An Ordinance to amend the Colonization of
Government Lands Act, 1912
[Gazette of Sindh
Extraordinary, Part I,
12th July, 2010]
No. S. Legis. 1(6)/2010,
dated 12-7-2010 ---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:--
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Colonization
of Government Lands Act, 1912, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the
Provincial Assembly is not in session and the Governor is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action.
Now, therefore in exercise of the powers conferred by
clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Colonization
of Government Lands (Amendment) Ordinance, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Colonization
of Government Lands Act, 1912, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the
Provincial Assembly is not in session and the Governor is satisfied that

Now, therefore in exercise of the powers conferred by
clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
2. Amendment of
section 10 of Act V of 1912.---In
the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912, in section 10,in subsection
(5), in the proviso, the full stop at the end shall be replaced by a colon and
thereafter the following proviso shall be added:--
"Provided further that the Chief Minister may extend
the period of completion of projects in respect of land granted for education
and health purposes in the cases where the delay in completion of project is
not on account of any negligence on the
part of grantee.".
